hook.say: Think you know the United States? Five questions, three seconds each, and the last one is tiny!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Florida has the longest coastline of the lower 48 states.
questions.sayAnswer: Florida! It has the longest coastline of the lower 48 states.

questions.q: Which is the southernmost US state?
questions.say: Which is the southernmost U.S. state?
questions.fact: Ka Lae, on Hawaii's Big Island, is the southernmost point of all 50 states.
questions.sayAnswer: Hawaii! The southern tip of its Big Island is the southernmost point of all 50 states.

questions.q: The lowest point in North America is in which state?
questions.fact: Badwater Basin in Death Valley lies about 85 meters below sea level.
questions.sayAnswer: California! Badwater Basin, in Death Valley, lies about 280 feet below sea level.

questions.q: Which state is NOT part of the Four Corners?
questions.fact: Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah all meet at a single point.
questions.sayAnswer: Nevada! Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah all meet at a single point.

questions.q: Which is the least populous US state capital?
questions.say: Which is the least populous U.S. state capital?
questions.fact: Montpelier, Vermont, has about 8,000 people and no McDonald's.
questions.sayAnswer: Mont-peel-yer! The capital of Vermont has only about 8,000 people, and no McDonald's.
